title: IAU Constellation Boundaries
source: VizieR catalogue VI/49 'Constellation Boundary Data' (Davenhall & Leggett 1989), after Delporte 1930
note: Each entry in boundary_rings_deg is a closed polygon ring (last vertex repeats the first); all but Serpens have exactly one ring (Serpens Caput and Cauda are two rings). ra_wraps_zero=true means the polygon crosses RA=0 deg, so handle the wrap when plotting or testing. Boundaries follow the B1875.0 RA/Dec grid; precess modern (J2000) coordinates to B1875.0 before doing point-in-polygon tests.
